request.state: Synthetic incident: checkout is completely unavailable. Every checkout attempt fails with HTTP 503; 100% of customers are unable to place an order. No workaround is available. Browsing the product catalog works. There is no evidence of a security incident or incorrect product prices. Severity policy: level 0 = normal operation; level 1 = minor cosmetic defect with no blocked purchases; level 2 = some purchases fail but others succeed; level 3 = all purchases fail and no workaround exists.

incident_category.instructions: Classify the checkout incident using the evidence provided.

criteria.availability: Customers cannot use the service because it is unavailable.
criteria.pricing: The service displays incorrect product prices.
criteria.security: Evidence of an unauthorized intrusion or data breach.

purchases_blocked.instructions: Are all customers currently unable to complete a purchase?

severity.instructions: Choose the severity level defined by the incident's explicit policy.
